# Micro-RPI Implementation Checklist

## Scope

- [ ] Accepted Micro-RPI read
- [ ] Relevant component rules read
- [ ] Relevant standards loaded
- [ ] Existing repository pattern inspected
- [ ] Unrelated code left unchanged

## Implementation

- [ ] Contract/state changes implemented
- [ ] Core behavior implemented
- [ ] DI/hosting/wiring updated where required
- [ ] Failure/retry/idempotency behavior implemented
- [ ] Observability added/updated where required
- [ ] No speculative abstractions added

## Verification

- [ ] Affected projects build
- [ ] Focused unit tests pass
- [ ] Relevant integration tests pass or prerequisites documented
- [ ] Contract/migration tests pass where applicable
- [ ] No tests weakened or removed to manufacture success

## Final report

Report:

- changed files,
- delivered behavior,
- commands run,
- test/build results,
- material deviations,
- unverified external behavior,
- remaining work outside scope.
